summary: Searches a hybrid file-path list for an entry whose string matches a2. First checks eight fixed entries (slots at this+0x10, +0x14, +0x18, +0x1C and +0x24, +0x28, +0x2C, +0x30; index 4 is skipped), then walks a variable-length array whose base is this+0x20, byte stride 200, entry count this+0x38. Every entry is a small object whose path string is a pointer at object+4, defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null; sub_588410 returns 0 on a match, and the matching entry pointer is returned. Returns 0 when a2 is null or no entry matches.
